title: Most Adults Can’t Score 80% On This Test
summary: Explore science, geography, history, food, words and everyday reasoning. Can you reach 80%?

about.body:
Explore science, geography, history, food, words and everyday reasoning. Can you reach 80%?

Choose one answer for each of the 10 questions. Get at least 8 correct to reach 80%. Reveal your result and review any questions you missed.

For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not a formal intelligence or educational assessment.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Did you reach 80%? Your score and strengths are ready.

profile-1.title: Quiz Master
profile-1.copy: You answered almost every question correctly. Your breakdown shows how that accuracy carried across the topics in this challenge.

profile-2.title: All-Round Ace
profile-2.copy: You made many accurate connections across this challenge. Explore your breakdown to see which topics were strongest.

profile-3.title: Sharp Contender
profile-3.copy: You connected many of the clues and facts. Your breakdown highlights the topics you handled best and the ones worth another look.

profile-4.title: Finding Your Rhythm
profile-4.copy: You found useful clues across several topics. The answer review can help you work through the questions that caught you out.

profile-5.title: Curious Challenger
profile-5.copy: Some topics were more familiar than others. Your review shows the correct answers and gives you a starting point for another attempt.

profile-6.title: A Fresh Starting Point
profile-6.copy: This challenge brought a mix of familiar and unfamiliar ideas. Use the answer review to explore the clues you missed.
